request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, wood and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows Luis on the left and Ana on the right in a bright room. Keep the photograph as it is: the same two people with the same faces, hair and clothes, the same room, light and framing, and Luis still asks Ana a question with raised eyebrows and an open mouth while Ana listens. Change ONLY what Luis holds: the envelope and the pen are gone, and instead he holds up ONE yellow wooden pencil with a pink eraser in one hand, upright between himself and Ana at chest height, clearly visible against the plain background; his other hand is open, palm up, in a questioning gesture. Exactly two people; no envelope, no pen, no paper. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
